scenes.text: Division undoes multiplication: if 7 times 8 equals 56, then 56 divided by 7 equals 8 and 56 divided by 8 equals 7.
Calculate 45 divided by 9. The answer is 5. 9 times 5 equals 45.
A club during a library project shares 25 pencils equally among 5 teams. How many per team? Pause to choose and explain.
A club during a library project shares 25 pencils equally among 5 teams. How many per team? The answer is 5. 5 times 5 equals 25.
